singleSkuPageInformation.text: Bring even more interstellar character to your Christmas display with this Disney Stitch and Angel infinity mirror light bundle, featuring a Stitch, Dancing Stitch and Angel. With three coordinated designs in different sizes, this set creates a bold and colourful festive display for Disney fans. The impressive 1.4m Stitch is illuminated by 1,437 blue, red, yellow, orange and white SMD LEDs, while the 75cm Dancing Stitch features a further 432 multicoloured SMD LEDs. Angel completes the trio with 309 pink, white and red SMD LEDs, giving the bundle a combined total of 2,178 LEDs. Each decoration uses the signature infinity mirror effect to create the illusion of lights continuing endlessly into the distance. Both Stitch designs are freestanding 360° decorations, allowing their illuminated displays to be enjoyed from different angles. The larger Stitch is supported by a sturdy aluminium stand and comes with a 5m lead cable, while the Dancing Stitch includes a 3m lead cable and is dressed in a cosy festive jumper and gloves. Angel adds a contrasting pink design, complete with a Santa hat and boots, wooden base and 3m clear lead cable. The two Stitch decorations are suitable for indoor and seasonal outdoor use, while Angel is designed for indoor use only. Whether displayed together as one statement arrangement or positioned separately throughout your festive space, this three-piece set brings colour, light and recognisable Disney character to your Christmas décor.
